narratives.advice.benign_cyst.en: Cyst: typically benign; an annual ultrasound check is adequate.
Cyst: most often benign; annual ultrasound surveillance is sufficient.
narratives.advice.benign_cyst.zh: 囊肿：通常为良性，通常不需要特殊处理，建议每年复查超声以观察变化。
囊肿：大多属于良性，一般无需特别处理，建议每年通过超声复查观察其变化。
囊肿：多数情况下为良性，通常不必特殊处理，建议每年复查超声，留意变化。
narratives.advice.body_fat.en: Raised body fat / visceral fat: create a calorie deficit, include cardio and strength training, and aim for a smaller waist.
narratives.advice.body_fat.zh: 体脂率/内脏脂肪偏高：建议合理控制热量摄入，结合有氧运动和抗阻训练，改善腰围，定期复查。
体脂率/内脏脂肪偏高：建议减少总热量摄入，增加有氧及抗阻锻炼，控制腰围，并定期复查。
体脂率/内脏脂肪偏高：可调整膳食结构以减少能量摄入，结合耐力活动与肌力锻炼，改善腹部脂肪堆积，并安排后续复评。
narratives.advice.bone.en: Low bone density: Support skeletal health with calcium and vitamin D, regular weight-loading activity, and follow-up DXA.
narratives.advice.bone.zh: 骨量减少/骨质疏松：建议摄入钙剂及维生素 D，配合适当负重活动，定期进行骨密度复查。
骨量减少/骨质疏松：日常保证钙和维生素 D 摄入，结合自身情况进行承重活动，并定期监测骨密度变化。
骨量减少/骨质疏松：可通过饮食或补剂增加钙与维生素 D 的摄取，规律开展适宜的承重锻炼，后续随访评估骨密度。
narratives.advice.brady.en: Sinus bradycardia: frequently found in active individuals; consider cardiology review if dizziness or fatigue develops; mm.
Sinus bradycardia: may reflect athletic conditioning; consider cardiology assessment if dizziness or fatigue develops; mm.
Sinus bradycardia: can occur with regular vigorous activity; seek a cardiologist’s advice if dizziness or fatigue is present; mm.
narratives.advice.brady.zh: 窦性心动过缓：没有不适时通常无需处理，运动人群中较常见；若出现头晕、乏力，建议到心内科就诊。
窦性心动过缓：如未感不适一般不必特殊处理，常见于经常运动者；出现头晕或乏力时请就诊心内科。
窦性心动过缓：无明显不适通常不需要处理，运动者中较为常见；若有头晕、乏力等情况，请至心内科就诊。
narratives.advice.breast.en: Fibrocystic change: Continue annual breast ultrasound; no specific therapy is required.
narratives.advice.breast.zh: 乳腺增生：建议调节情绪，规律生活，每年复查乳腺超声。
乳腺增生：日常注意调适情绪、避免熬夜，并按年进行乳腺超声检查。
乳腺增生：保持良好心态，养成稳定的生活节奏，每年接受乳腺超声检查。
narratives.advice.breast_nodule.en: Breast nodule: schedule follow-up sonography at 6 months; seek breast clinic assessment if warranted.
Breast nodule: return for ultrasound in 6 months; referral to the breast clinic may be made if clinically indicated.
narratives.advice.breast_nodule.zh: 乳腺结节：可在 6 个月后复查乳腺超声，如有需要请就诊乳腺外科。
乳腺结节：可在 6 个月后安排乳腺超声复诊，如有需要请咨询乳腺外科。
乳腺结节：建议间隔 6 个月进行乳腺超声随访；必要时到乳腺外科进一步评估。
narratives.advice.dental.zh: 口腔：建议到口腔科处理龋齿、牙结石，保持早晚刷牙的习惯，定期洁牙。
口腔：如有龋齿或牙结石，建议请口腔科评估并处理；养成晨起、睡前刷牙的习惯，按期接受洁牙。
口腔：可到口腔科检查龋病及牙结石并作相应处置，日常坚持早晚清洁牙齿，适时进行专业洁治。
narratives.advice.ecg_minor.zh: 心电图轻度异常：建议根据临床情况评估，必要时到心内科就诊并复查心电图。
心电图轻度异常：请结合整体健康状况评估，视情况安排心内科进一步检查及心电图复测。
心电图轻度异常：综合症状与临床资料判断后，如有需要可接受心内科诊察并再次检查心电图。
narratives.advice.echo_minor.en: Minor echocardiographic finding: may be physiological or age-related; assess in clinical context and monitor blood pressure.
Minor echocardiographic finding: frequently reflects physiological or age-related change; interpret clinically and maintain blood pressure control.
Minor echocardiographic finding: often represents a physiological or age-related change; correlate with clinical status and ensure blood pressure is controlled.
narratives.advice.echo_minor.zh: 心脏超声轻度异常：可能与生理因素或年龄相关变化有关，建议结合临床情况控制血压，必要时到心内科随诊。
心脏超声轻度异常：此类表现常与生理状态或年龄因素有关，可请临床医生综合判断；平时留意血压管理，按需到心内科复查。
心脏超声轻度异常：所见改变可能与生理差异及年龄有关，请结合整体健康状况管理血压，并在需要时接受心内科评估。
narratives.advice.ent.en: ENT: limit exposure to irritants and stop smoking; seek ENT review if symptoms develop.
ENT: avoid exposure to irritants and quit smoking; arrange ENT review if symptomatic.
ENT: steer clear of irritants and cease smoking; obtain ENT review if symptoms occur.
narratives.advice.ent.zh: 耳鼻喉科：建议清淡饮食、戒烟，如有需要请至耳鼻喉科就诊。
耳鼻喉科：建议减少刺激性饮食，戒烟，必要时可就诊耳鼻喉科。
耳鼻喉科：日常饮食宜清淡，远离烟草；如有需要，可到耳鼻喉科进一步咨询。
narratives.advice.eye.en: Eyes: maintain eye hygiene; check refraction and wear spectacles if needed.
Eyes: practise eye hygiene; assess refraction and use spectacles if required.
Eyes: keep up eye hygiene; have refraction checked and use spectacles if needed.
narratives.advice.eye.zh: 眼科：建议保持良好用眼习惯，必要时进行验光配镜。
眼科：请注意用眼卫生，如有需要可验光配镜。
眼科：建议合理用眼，必要时到眼科验光配镜。
narratives.advice.fatty_liver.en: Fatty liver: follow a controlled diet, exercise regularly and manage weight; limit alcohol; repeat liver function tests and ultrasound at regular intervals.
Fatty liver: maintain dietary control, engage in regular exercise and manage weight; restrict alcohol; periodically repeat liver function tests and ultrasound.
narratives.advice.fatty_liver.zh: 脂肪肝：建议调整饮食结构，增加运动，控制体重并限制饮酒，定期检查肝功能和肝脏超声。
脂肪肝：宜合理饮食、加强锻炼以控制体重，减少饮酒，并定期复查肝功能及肝脏超声。
脂肪肝：建议注意饮食管理，积极运动、维持适宜体重，限制饮酒，定期进行肝功能及肝脏超声检查。
narratives.advice.fibroid.en: Uterine fibroid: pelvic ultrasound annually; arrange gynaecology review should menorrhagia develop.
Uterine fibroid: continue annual pelvic ultrasound; consult gynaecology if menorrhagia arises.
Uterine fibroid: arrange a pelvic scan each year, and seek specialist gynaecology input if menorrhagia appears.
narratives.advice.fibroid.zh: 子宫肌瘤：建议每年进行妇科超声检查，若月经量增多，请前往妇科就诊。
子宫肌瘤：建议每年定期复查妇科超声，出现月经量增多时请就诊妇科。
子宫肌瘤：每年进行妇科超声随访；若经血量增加，应前往妇科评估。
narratives.advice.gb_polyp.en: Gallbladder polyp: Follow up with ultrasound every 6–12 months; seek hepatobiliary surgery consultation if it grows or exceeds 10 mm.
Gallbladder polyp: Continue ultrasound surveillance every 6–12 months; consult hepatobiliary surgery if growth is noted or it exceeds 10 mm.
Gallbladder polyp: Follow with sonography every 6–12 months; seek hepatobiliary surgery consultation for growth or a size greater than 10 mm.
narratives.advice.gb_polyp.zh: 胆囊息肉样病变：请以 6–12 个月为间隔进行超声随访；如发现病灶长大或直径超出 10mm，需到肝胆外科进一步诊治。
胆囊息肉样病变：可定期安排超声观察，复查间隔为 6–12 个月；若息肉持续增长或直径达到超过 10mm 的情况，请前往肝胆外科就诊。
胆囊息肉样病变：建议纳入超声随访，间隔 6–12 个月；病变一旦增大，或直径大于 10mm，应转至肝胆外科评估。
narratives.advice.gb_stone.en: Gallstones: follow a low-fat diet, eat regular meals, and attend periodic review; seek care if right upper quadrant pain develops.
Gallstones: Favor low-fat eating and consistent meal timing, with routine follow-up; obtain care if right upper quadrant pain occurs.
narratives.advice.gb_stone.zh: 胆囊结石：建议选择低脂饮食，按时进食早餐，定期复查；若出现右上腹疼痛，请及时就医。
胆囊结石：日常宜清淡低脂，规律吃早餐并定期复查；如有右上腹痛，请及时就诊。
胆囊结石：建议控制脂肪摄入，保持早餐规律，定期复查；出现右上腹疼痛时应及时就医。
narratives.advice.gyn.en: Gynaecology: Attend periodic reproductive-health reviews and take part in cervical screening.
Gynaecology: Arrange ongoing specialist assessments alongside cervical screening.
Gynaecology: Keep up with scheduled pelvic health reviews and cervical screening.
narratives.advice.gyn.zh: 妇科：建议定期开展妇科检查，并进行宫颈细胞学筛查。
妇科：建议将妇科检查及宫颈细胞学筛查纳入常规健康管理。
妇科：定期关注妇科健康，及时开展宫颈细胞学筛查和相关检查。
narratives.advice.hp.en: H. pylori positive: refer to gastroenterology for eradication treatment.
H. pylori positive: please see a gastroenterologist to discuss eradication treatment.
H. pylori positive: referral to gastroenterology is advised to plan eradication.
narratives.advice.hp.zh: 幽门螺杆菌阳性：可至消化内科咨询，由医生结合情况判断是否开展根除治疗；用餐时尽量实行分餐。
幽门螺杆菌阳性：建议由消化内科医生评估后决定是否接受根除治疗，日常饮食尽量采取分餐方式。
幽门螺杆菌阳性：请咨询消化内科，了解是否适合进行根除治疗，并与他人分开用餐。
narratives.advice.kidney_stone.en: Kidney stone: drink more fluids, remain active, and have periodic ultrasound; seek care for flank pain or haematuria.
Kidney stone: maintain good hydration, keep active, and undergo ultrasound periodically; seek care if flank pain or haematuria develops.
Kidney stone: increase your fluid intake, stay physically active, and arrange regular ultrasound; seek care if you experience flank pain or haematuria.
narratives.advice.kidney_stone.zh: 肾结石：建议增加饮水量，适度活动，定期复查泌尿系超声；若有腰痛或血尿，请及时就诊。
肾结石：平时宜多喝水、适当锻炼，并定期进行泌尿系超声复查；出现腰痛、血尿时应及时就医。
肾结石：建议保证充足饮水，适度运动，定期复查泌尿系超声；如有腰痛或血尿，请尽快就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_anemia.en: Anaemia ({items}): determine the cause; advise an iron-rich diet; consider review by haematology.
narratives.advice.lab_anemia.zh: 贫血（{items}）：建议明确贫血原因，适当增加含铁食物，至血液科或消化科就诊。
贫血（{items}）：建议进一步查明病因，多摄入含铁食物，并到血液科或消化科咨询。
贫血（{items}）：建议排查相关病因，补充富含铁的食物，必要时就诊血液科或消化科。
narratives.advice.lab_bmi.en: Overweight/obesity: limit energy intake while increasing activity.
narratives.advice.lab_bmi.zh: 超重/肥胖：建议减少饮食摄入，增加身体活动，帮助减轻体重。
超重/肥胖：建议调整饮食结构，加强运动锻炼，控制体重。
超重/肥胖：宜优化膳食结构，坚持规律锻炼，逐步降低体重。
narratives.advice.lab_bp.en: Raised blood pressure: reduce salt intake, monitor blood pressure at home, and seek cardiology assessment if it persists.
Raised blood pressure: limit dietary salt and track blood pressure at home; cardiology review is advised if the elevation continues.
narratives.advice.lab_bp.zh: 血压偏高：建议减少盐分摄入，保持规律作息，在家测量并记录血压；如血压持续升高，请至心内科就诊。
血压偏高：建议清淡饮食、规律作息，定期在家自测血压并做好记录；若持续升高，请就诊心内科。
血压偏高：建议低盐饮食并保持作息规律，居家监测血压、及时记录；如血压一直偏高，建议心内科就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_cardiac.en: Abnormal cardiac markers ({items}): please have cardiology evaluate, obtain an ECG, recheck markers and perform echocardiography.
Abnormal cardiac markers ({items}): recommend specialist cardiac assessment, with ECG, another marker check and cardiac ultrasound.
narratives.advice.lab_cardiac.zh: 心肌标志物异常（{items}）：建议由心内科医生评估，并复测心电图、心肌标志物，完成心脏超声检查。
心肌标志物异常（{items}）：请至心内科进一步评估，完善心电图、心肌标志物及心脏超声检查。
narratives.advice.lab_cbc.en: Abnormal blood count ({items}): repeat CBC; refer for haematology review if abnormalities persist.
Abnormal blood count ({items}): Please have a CBC repeated and consult haematology if the result remains abnormal.
Abnormal blood count ({items}): Follow-up CBC is advised; ongoing abnormalities warrant a haematology assessment.
narratives.advice.lab_cbc.zh: 血常规异常（{items}）：建议再次检查血常规，如有需要可就诊血液科。
血常规异常（{items}）：建议择期复核血常规结果，必要时请血液科评估。
血常规异常（{items}）：可再次检测血常规，如有需要可挂血液科就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_cervical.en: Abnormal cervical screening ({items}): Seek gynaecology input, with cervical examination by colposcopy guided by the findings; plan another HPV test 12 months later.
narratives.advice.lab_cervical.zh: 宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：请至妇科进一步评估，医生认为有必要时可完善阴道镜检查；高危型 HPV 阳性者建议间隔 12 个月复查。
宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：建议前往妇科接受进一步诊治，并根据情况安排阴道镜检查；如高危型 HPV 检测为阳性，请于 12 个月后复查。
宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：请结合检查结果至妇科评估，必要时进一步做阴道镜检查；高危型 HPV 阳性者可在 12 个月后再次检查。
narratives.advice.lab_coag.en: Abnormal coagulation ({items}): exclude sampling artefact, then repeat; seek haematology review if the abnormality persists.
Abnormal coagulation ({items}): repeat once sampling artefact has been excluded; refer for haematology review if persistent.
Abnormal coagulation ({items}): After ruling out sampling artefact, repeat the assessment; persistent abnormalities warrant haematology input.
narratives.advice.lab_coag.zh: 凝血功能异常（{items}）：排除采血因素影响后，建议复查凝血功能，必要时咨询血液科。
凝血功能异常（{items}）：建议先排除采血因素，再行凝血功能复查；必要时前往血液科就诊。
凝血功能异常（{items}）：可先核实采血过程是否规范，再复测凝血指标；如结果仍有异常，建议咨询血液科。
narratives.advice.lab_glucose.en: Abnormal glucose ({items}): Encourage nutrition and activity measures; reassess with fasting glucose and HbA1c, and seek endocrinology input when clinically appropriate.
narratives.advice.lab_glucose.zh: 血糖异常（{items}）：建议注意饮食管理并坚持运动，复查空腹血糖与糖化血红蛋白，必要时前往内分泌科就诊。
血糖异常（{items}）：日常注意膳食管理并保持规律活动，后续检测空腹血糖与糖化血红蛋白；如有需要，咨询内分泌科。
血糖异常（{items}）：建议改善饮食习惯，增加身体活动，并安排空腹血糖和糖化血红蛋白复测；必要时接受内分泌科评估。
narratives.advice.lab_hepatitis.en: Positive hepatitis serology ({items}): arrange hepatology assessment, liver function tests, HBV DNA and ultrasound; screen household contacts and offer vaccination.
Positive hepatitis serology ({items}): refer for hepatology review and liver function tests, HBV DNA and ultrasound; assess household contacts for screening and vaccination.
narratives.advice.lab_hepatitis.zh: 肝炎病毒标志物阳性（{items}）：建议咨询感染科或肝病科，复查肝功能、HBV-DNA和肝脏超声，并建议家人接受筛查及疫苗接种。
肝炎病毒标志物阳性（{items}）：宜由感染科或肝病科医生评估，并复核肝功能、HBV-DNA及肝脏超声；建议家人接受筛查和疫苗接种。
肝炎病毒标志物阳性（{items}）：可咨询肝病科或感染科，进一步检查肝功能、HBV-DNA及肝脏超声；家人也应进行筛查并接种疫苗。
narratives.advice.lab_hp.en: H. pylori antibody positive: serology cannot tell whether infection is current or past; confirm using a urea breath test.
narratives.advice.lab_hp.zh: 幽门螺杆菌抗体阳性：仅凭抗体阳性不能判断当前感染或既往感染，建议完善碳13/碳14呼气试验，确认后再决定是否根除。
幽门螺杆菌抗体阳性：血清抗体结果无法判断感染是否仍在持续，可先做碳13/碳14呼气试验，再评估是否需要根除治疗。
幽门螺杆菌抗体阳性：仅凭抗体检测不能确认当前是否存在感染，建议补充碳13/碳14呼气试验，并据此讨论根除治疗。
narratives.advice.lab_immune.en: Abnormal immunology ({items}): recommend rheumatology assessment, with correlation to joint symptoms; mm.
Abnormal immunology ({items}): seek rheumatology review and assess alongside joint symptoms; mm.
Abnormal immunology ({items}): seek rheumatology input, guided by joint symptoms; mm.
narratives.advice.lab_immune.zh: 免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：如有关节不适，宜请风湿免疫科医师评估，并酌情安排后续检查。
免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：建议咨询风湿免疫科，结合关节表现判断是否需要进一步筛查。
免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：可挂风湿免疫科，向医生说明关节相关情况，以便制定后续检查方案。
narratives.advice.lab_lipid.en: Dyslipidaemia ({items}): adopt a low-fat diet, manage weight, and stay active; repeat lipid testing in 3–6 months.
Dyslipidaemia ({items}): reduce dietary fat, manage weight, and exercise; reassess lipids in 3–6 months.
narratives.advice.lab_lipid.zh: 血脂异常（{items}）：建议减少脂肪摄入，保持体重适宜，加强体育锻炼，3–6 个月复查血脂；如有需要，可至心内科或内分泌科就诊。
血脂异常（{items}）：建议以低脂饮食为主，注意体重管理并积极运动，3–6 个月后复查血脂；必要时请心内科或内分泌科评估。
血脂异常（{items}）：饮食宜清淡并减少脂肪摄入，维持适宜体重，规律进行身体活动，3–6 个月后复测血脂；如有需要，可至心内科或内分泌科进一步诊治。
narratives.advice.lab_liver.en: Abnormal liver function ({items}): refrain from alcohol and hepatotoxic medication; recheck in 2–4 weeks.
Abnormal liver function ({items}): abstain from alcohol and avoid medicines that may harm the liver; repeat testing in 2–4 weeks.
Abnormal liver function ({items}): abstain from alcohol and medicines that can affect the liver; arrange a follow-up test in 2–4 weeks.
narratives.advice.lab_liver.zh: 肝功能异常（{items}）：建议停止饮酒，避免使用损害肝脏的药物，注意休息，2–4 周后复查肝功能。
肝功能异常（{items}）：近期应停止饮酒，用药前确认不会加重肝损害；注意休养，2–4 周后复测肝功能。
narratives.advice.lab_other.en: Other abnormal results ({items}): interpret in clinical context and repeat.
Other abnormal results ({items}): assess in clinical context and arrange a recheck.
narratives.advice.lab_other.zh: 其他检验异常（{items}）：请结合临床表现-定期复查。
其他检验异常（{items}）：建议依据临床情况-定期复查。
其他检验异常（{items}）：可依据临床情况进一步评估-并安排后续复核。
narratives.advice.lab_pancreas.zh: 胰酶异常（{items}）：建议复查；若出现上腹痛，请至消化内科就诊。
胰酶异常（{items}）：可复查；若有上腹痛，建议就诊消化内科。
胰酶异常（{items}）：可安排复查；若感到上腹部不适，建议到消化内科进一步评估。
narratives.advice.lab_renal.en: Abnormal renal function ({items}): ensure adequate hydration, avoid nephrotoxic drugs, and arrange nephrology review.
Abnormal renal function ({items}): maintain hydration, avoid nephrotoxic agents, and seek nephrology assessment.
Abnormal renal function ({items}): stay well hydrated, avoid kidney-harming drugs, and consult nephrology.
narratives.advice.lab_renal.zh: 肾功能异常（{items}）：建议适当增加饮水，避免使用肾毒性药物，并至肾内科复查。
肾功能异常（{items}）：平时注意保证水分摄入，勿自行使用可能损伤肾脏的药物，可至肾内科进一步诊治。
肾功能异常（{items}）：关注日常水分补充，尽量不使用对肾脏有害的药品，并请肾内科医生评估后续复查安排。
narratives.advice.lab_renal_early.en: Raised urine albumin ({items}): consider this a potential early marker of kidney damage; optimize blood pressure and glucose, with UACR reassessment within 3 months.
Raised urine albumin ({items}): could reflect incipient kidney injury; review blood pressure and glucose control, and arrange another UACR within 3 months.
Raised urine albumin ({items}): an early renal change is possible; prioritize blood pressure and glucose management, then check UACR again within 3 months.
narratives.advice.lab_renal_early.zh: 尿微量白蛋白异常（{items}）：该结果可能与肾脏早期受累有关，日常应加强血压和血糖管理，并于 3 个月内检测尿白蛋白/肌酐比值，视情况前往肾内科评估。
尿微量白蛋白异常（{items}）：存在肾脏早期受影响的可能，建议持续关注血压、血糖，并在 3 个月内完成尿白蛋白/肌酐比值检查，如结果仍异常可咨询肾内科。
尿微量白蛋白异常（{items}）：建议结合此项结果留意肾脏健康，保持血压与血糖平稳，3 个月内安排尿白蛋白/肌酐比值检测，必要时接受肾内科进一步评估。
narratives.advice.lab_stool.en: Positive faecal occult blood: gastroenterology consultation advised; consider endoscopy where indicated.
narratives.advice.lab_stool.zh: 便潜血阳性：建议至消化内科进一步评估，必要时进行胃肠镜检查。
便潜血阳性：建议前往消化内科进一步评估，并视情况接受胃肠镜检查。
便潜血阳性：可至消化内科进一步诊察，医生将结合情况判断是否需要胃肠镜检查。
narratives.advice.lab_thyroid.en: Abnormal thyroid function ({items}): Please arrange an endocrinology consultation.
Abnormal thyroid function ({items}): Please seek review by endocrinology.
narratives.advice.lab_thyroid.zh: 甲状腺功能异常（{items}）：可预约内分泌科评估，并按医嘱再次检测甲状腺功能。
甲状腺功能异常（{items}）：建议由内分泌科医生进一步诊察，同时安排甲状腺功能复测。
甲状腺功能异常（{items}）：请到内分泌专科咨询，后续进行甲状腺功能检测以复核结果。
narratives.advice.lab_tumor.en: Raised tumour marker ({items}): A slight increase on its own may not indicate a specific cause; consider follow-up testing after 1–3 months.
Raised tumour marker ({items}): When the finding is modest and isolated, it is commonly non-specific; reassessment is advised within 1–3 months.
narratives.advice.lab_tumor.zh: 肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：单项指标轻度升高通常不提示明确临床问题，建议 1–3 个月后复查，必要时咨询专科。
肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：如仅有一项指标轻微超出范围，通常不提示明确临床问题，可于 1–3 个月后复查；如有需要，再咨询相关专科。
肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：孤立的轻度异常多不代表明确临床问题，建议间隔 1–3 个月再次检测，并根据情况考虑专科评估。
narratives.advice.lab_ua.en: Raised uric acid: choose a low-purine diet, restrict alcohol, stay well hydrated, and attend periodic review.
narratives.advice.lab_ua.zh: 尿酸偏高：建议选择低嘌呤饮食，减少饮酒，适当多饮水，并定期复查。
尿酸偏高：宜减少高嘌呤食物摄入，限制饮酒，多喝水，按期复查。
尿酸偏高：建议饮食以低嘌呤为主，少饮酒、多饮水，并定期检查。
narratives.advice.lab_urine.en: Abnormal urinalysis ({items}): obtain a repeat sample using clean-catch technique.
Abnormal urinalysis ({items}): A fresh clean-catch urine specimen is advised for reassessment.
narratives.advice.lab_urine.zh: 尿常规异常（{items}）：建议规范留取清洁中段尿后复查，如有需要可到肾内科或泌尿科就诊。
尿常规异常（{items}）：建议规范留取清洁中段尿，再进行尿液检查；如需进一步评估，可咨询肾内科或泌尿科。
尿常规异常（{items}）：可重新采集清洁中段尿送检，若需进一步诊治，建议到肾内科或泌尿科就诊。
narratives.advice.lung_function.en: Abnormal spirometry: smoking cessation and avoidance of dust and irritants are advised; arrange respiratory review with post-bronchodilator spirometry.
narratives.advice.lung_function.zh: 肺通气功能异常：为保护呼吸道健康，请戒烟并尽量减少粉尘、刺激性气体吸入，至呼吸科复评肺功能（支气管舒张试验）。
肺通气功能异常：日常避免烟草、粉尘及刺激性气体暴露，尽早戒烟，并赴呼吸科进行肺功能复查（支气管舒张试验）。
肺通气功能异常：建议停止吸烟，做好防护以避开粉尘和刺激性气体，并由呼吸科复核肺功能（支气管舒张试验）。
narratives.advice.lung_markings.zh: 两肺纹理增粗：这种表现与吸烟及慢性支气管炎相关，宜尽早停止吸烟，必要时请呼吸科医生评估。
两肺纹理增粗：可能和长期吸烟、慢性支气管炎有关，建议远离烟草，若情况需要可咨询呼吸科。
两肺纹理增粗：此类影像改变在吸烟者或慢性支气管炎患者中较常见，建议戒除吸烟习惯，并视情况接受呼吸科诊治。
narratives.advice.lung_nodule.en: Small pulmonary nodule: schedule repeat chest CT in 12 months and discontinue smoking.
Small pulmonary nodule: schedule follow-up chest CT at the 12-month mark; discontinue smoking.
Small pulmonary nodule: obtain surveillance chest CT in 12 months; refrain from tobacco use.
narratives.advice.lung_nodule.zh: 肺微小结节：可于 12 个月后安排胸部 CT 随访，并保持不吸烟。
肺微小结节：宜在 12 个月后进行胸部 CT 复查，远离烟草。
肺微小结节：请坚持戒烟，12 个月后再接受胸部 CT 检查。
narratives.advice.prostate.en: Prostatic hyperplasia: follow up with urology; obtain PSA periodically.
Prostatic hyperplasia: periodic urology follow-up and PSA monitoring.
Prostatic hyperplasia: continue surveillance with urology and serial PSA monitoring.
narratives.advice.prostate.zh: 前列腺增生：建议少坐、勿憋尿，定期到泌尿外科随诊并复查前列腺特异性抗原。
前列腺增生：平时宜增加起身活动，及时排尿，并到泌尿外科复诊，按期检测前列腺特异性抗原。
前列腺增生：注意减少连续静坐，切勿长时间忍尿；请泌尿外科评估，并持续监测前列腺特异性抗原。
narratives.advice.surgical_minor.en: Surgical: Keep proper posture and stay active; avoid sitting or standing for long stretches; consult a specialist if needed.
Surgical: Focus on posture and regular exercise; minimize prolonged sitting or standing; consider specialist review if needed.
narratives.advice.surgical_minor.zh: 外科：建议保持良好姿势，适度锻炼，避免长时间久坐或久站，必要时前往相关科室就诊。
外科：注意调整姿势，适当进行锻炼，尽量避免久坐久站，如有需要可到相关科室就诊。
外科：建议注意日常姿势并适度锻炼，避免长时间坐着或站立，必要时至相关科室就诊。
narratives.advice.tcm.en: TCM constitutional imbalance: follow dietary and daily routine adjustments suited to constitution type; seek TCM consultation if desired.
TCM constitutional imbalance: align diet and daily routine with constitution type; consult TCM if desired.
TCM constitutional imbalance: align meals and everyday habits with constitution type; a TCM consultation is optional.
narratives.advice.tcm.zh: 中医体质偏颇：建议结合体质特点调节饮食与日常起居，保持作息规律，必要时至中医科就诊调理。
中医体质偏颇：可依据体质类型合理安排饮食起居，养成规律作息习惯，必要时前往中医科调理。
中医体质偏颇：建议按体质情况调整饮食和生活作息，注意规律休息，必要时就诊中医科进行调理。
narratives.advice.thyroid_diffuse.en: Diffuse thyroid change: Recommend endocrinology assessment, including thyroid function and antibody tests.
narratives.advice.thyroid_diffuse.zh: 甲状腺弥漫性病变：建议安排内分泌科评估，并进一步检测甲状腺功能及相关抗体。
甲状腺弥漫性病变：可到内分泌科就诊，由专科医生评估甲状腺功能与相关抗体情况。
甲状腺弥漫性病变：建议结合内分泌科诊疗意见，完善甲状腺功能和相关抗体检查。
narratives.advice.thyroid_nodule.en: Thyroid nodule: obtain follow-up thyroid imaging and function testing every 6–12 months; refer to endocrinology when warranted.
Thyroid nodule: arrange thyroid sonographic surveillance and function testing every 6–12 months; involve endocrinology if clinically indicated.
narratives.advice.thyroid_nodule.zh: 甲状腺结节：请按每 6–12 个月一次的间隔检查甲状腺超声与甲状腺功能；如有必要，咨询内分泌科。
甲状腺结节：可每 6–12 个月安排甲状腺超声和甲状腺功能评估，视情况进一步至内分泌科诊治。
甲状腺结节：后续随访可定于每 6–12 个月，复查甲状腺超声和功能指标，必要时接受内分泌科评估。
narratives.advice.vascular.en: Vascular finding: keep blood pressure, lipids and glucose controlled; quit smoking; follow a low-salt, low-fat diet; have periodic carotid ultrasound.
Vascular finding: manage blood pressure, lipids and glucose; avoid smoking; maintain a low-salt, low-fat diet; undergo carotid ultrasound periodically.
Vascular finding: control blood pressure, lipids and glucose; stop tobacco use; choose a low-salt, low-fat diet; repeat carotid ultrasound at intervals.
narratives.advice.vascular.zh: 血管相关异常：建议将血压、血脂、血糖控制在适宜范围，戒烟并坚持低盐低脂饮食，定期进行颈动脉超声复查。
血管相关异常：请关注血压、血脂及血糖的日常管理，远离烟草，饮食以清淡为宜并减少盐分和脂肪，后续安排颈动脉超声随访。
血管相关异常：保持血压、血脂和血糖平稳，停止吸烟，平时少吃高盐、高脂食物，并按时接受颈动脉超声检查。
narratives.aux.abd_us.organs.gallbladder: Gallbladder is normal in size, with no wall thickening or stones.
Normal-sized gallbladder with a non-thickened wall and no stones.
Gallbladder size is within normal limits; no wall thickening or stones are seen.
胆囊形态及大小正常，囊壁不增厚，腔内未探及明显异常回声。
胆囊大小形态正常，囊壁厚度未见异常，腔内未发现明显异常回声。
胆囊形态与大小未见异常，囊壁光滑，腔内未探及异常回声。
narratives.aux.abd_us.organs.kidneys.nor: 双肾形态、大小未见异常，皮髓质界限清楚，集合系统无分离，未探及明显异常回声。
双肾轮廓规整，体积未见增大或缩小，肾实质层次清晰，肾盂肾盏无扩张，未探及显著异常回声。
双侧肾脏外观正常，实质与髓质界限分明，集合部未见扩张，内部回声未发现明显异常。
narratives.aux.abd_us.organs.liver.norma: Liver is normal in size and contour, with homogeneous echotexture and no dilatation of the intrahepatic ducts.
The liver demonstrates normal size and contour, homogeneous echotexture, and nondilated intrahepatic ducts.
The liver demonstrates normal dimensions, a regular contour, and uniform echotexture; the intrahepatic ducts are of normal caliber.
肝脏大小及形态正常，表面光整，实质回声分布均匀，肝内管道显示清楚，门静脉内径未见异常。
肝脏形态大小正常，轮廓光滑，实质回声均匀，肝内管道显示良好，门静脉内径无明显异常。
肝脏轮廓规整、体积适中，表面平整；内部回声细腻均一，肝内管状结构辨认清楚，门静脉口径未见异常。
narratives.aux.abd_us.organs.pancreas.no: Pancreas is unremarkable, with no ductal dilatation.
Pancreas appears normal, and its duct is nondilated.
胰腺大小及形态正常，实质回声均匀，胰管未见扩张。
胰腺形态、大小未见异常，回声分布均匀，胰管不扩张。
胰腺轮廓及体积未见异常，实质回声分布均匀，胰管口径正常。
narratives.aux.abd_us.organs.spleen.norm: 脾脏形态及大小未见异常，实质回声均匀。
narratives.aux.breast_us.organs.breast.n: Normal fibroglandular tissue without focal abnormality. No axillary lymphadenopathy.
No focal abnormality is identified in the fibroglandular tissue; the axillae show no enlarged nodes.
The fibroglandular parenchyma is within normal limits, without a discrete lesion or abnormal axillary nodes.
乳腺腺体回声分布均一，组织分层显示清楚，未探及可疑占位；两侧腋窝区未发现异常增大的淋巴结。
双侧乳房腺体结构层次可辨，实质回声均质，未检出局灶性肿块；腋窝区域未显示肿大淋巴结。
两侧乳腺组织分层清晰，内部回声一致，未见局部异常占位影。双侧腋窝未见增大的淋巴结。
narratives.aux.carotid_us.organs.carotid: Common and internal carotid arteries are normal in calibre, with smooth intima-media and no plaque; measurements in mm.
The common and internal carotid arteries show normal calibre and smooth intima-media, without plaque; measurements in mm.
Normal calibre of the common and internal carotid arteries, with smooth intima-media and absence of plaque; measurements in mm.
颈部双侧总动脉及内动脉走行通畅，管腔口径处于正常范围，内中膜连续平整，未探及显著粥样斑块。
双侧颈动脉主干及内支管腔无明显狭窄，内中膜界面规则，未显示明确斑块，彩色血流充盈良好。
所见双侧颈总及颈内动脉管腔宽度正常，管壁内中膜均匀规整，未发现确切斑块回声，血流信号连续。
narratives.aux.chest_ct.finding_normal.e: No pulmonary nodules or consolidation are seen. The lungs are clear, the airways are patent, and there is no mediastinal lymphadenopathy or pleural effusion.
Clear lungs without nodules or consolidation. Patent airways. No mediastinal lymphadenopathy or pleural effusion.
narratives.aux.chest_ct.finding_normal.z: 双侧肺部透亮度均匀，肺血管纹理分布规整，未显示明确实质性异常。中央气道开放通畅，纵隔区域未发现增大的淋巴结。心脏轮廓大小无异常，胸膜腔内未见液体积聚。
肺内含气状态良好，肺纹理形态及分布未见异常，未观察到实质性病灶。气管及支气管未见阻塞，纵隔淋巴结无增大表现。心脏大小处于正常范围，双侧胸腔未见积液。
双肺未见异常密度影，肺纹理清晰且排列自然。气道通畅，纵隔内无肿大淋巴结影。心影无增大，胸腔内未发现液体聚集。
narratives.aux.chest_xray.finding_normal: The lungs are clear, and the cardiomediastinal silhouette is normal. Costophrenic angles remain sharp.
Clear lungs. Normal cardiomediastinal silhouette. Sharp costophrenic angles.
肺内血管支气管影分布自然，未显示明确异常实质密度。心脏轮廓及体积处于正常范围，两侧膈肌边缘平顺，肋膈隐窝清楚。
双肺野未见可辨认的实质性异常影，肺纹理走行及分布无明显异常。心脏外形、大小正常，膈肌线条连续规整，双侧肋膈沟呈尖角。
胸部影像未发现肺实质异常征象，肺内纹理表现自然；心脏影无形态或体积异常。两侧膈肌弧线光滑，肋膈窦清晰开放。
两侧肺野清晰，肺纹理分布自然。心影大小正常。膈面光整，肋膈角锐利。
双肺野透亮清晰，肺纹理走行及分布自然。心影未见增大，膈面光滑，肋膈角锐利。
肺野清晰，肺纹理无异常走行。心影不大，膈面平滑，肋膈角锐利。
narratives.aux.echo.finding_normal.en.0: Normal dimensions of the chambers and thickness of the walls; normal valve structure and function; no significant regurgitation or fluid around the heart.
Chambers are normal in size and walls in thickness; the valves show unremarkable structure and function, with no appreciable backflow or fluid surrounding the heart.
